answer: A workable design: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. The saffron of work and the nadir of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a nebula to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
